article.hook: That sharp sting from nowhere isn’t new. Lilith in Cancer rewinds past hurts and replays them like scenes you didn’t sign up to watch again.
article.lived: For about nine months, moods get hijacked by echoes of old rejections or neglect. We find ourselves protecting not just people but the fragile parts of memory that still ache. The past sneaks into the small moments - a glance, a word, a silence - and colors what feels safe or unsafe now.
article.turn: Deep care becomes a trap when it’s a shield around wounds no one agreed to reopen. Instead of moving through pain, we loop on what hurt us before and draft new stories from old scars. Letting memory rule will keep you locked in yesterday’s room with no exit.
moves: Name one feeling from the past that’s shaping your mood today.
Notice when you’re guarding a memory more than a person.
Tell one truth about your past hurt without rewriting it.
